description: This file defines the class PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Html, responsible for converting spreadsheets into HTML format. It contains methods for generating HTML headers, footers, styles, sheet data, navigation, and handling embedded images and charts within the spreadsheet. It manages cell formats, merged cells, and other worksheet properties to produce a comprehensive HTML representation of an Excel-like spreadsheet.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: Responsible for converting PhpSpreadsheet objects into HTML representation, including generating headers, footers, styles, sheet data, images, charts, and handling cell formatting and merged cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Html writer with a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the generated HTML to a file or output resource.

methods.name: generateHtmlAll
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML string for the entire spreadsheet.

methods.name: setEditHtmlCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to edit the generated HTML before output.

methods.name: generateHTMLHeader
methods.description: Creates the HTML header section, including meta tags and styles.

methods.name: generateSheetData
methods.description: Generates the HTML representation of sheet data, including rows, cells, merges.

methods.name: generateNavigation
methods.description: Creates the navigation tabs for multiple sheets.

methods.name: buildCSS
methods.description: Builds the CSS styles used for styling the HTML output.

methods.name: assembleCSS
methods.description: Converts an array of CSS properties and values into a CSS string.

methods.name: formatColor
methods.description: Adds inline span styles to format cell text with color if specified.

methods.name: calculateSpans
methods.description: Calculates the colspan and rowspan for merged cells to be correctly represented in HTML.

methods.name: writeComment
methods.description: Inserts comments in cells as HTML annotations.
